name: Hephaestus
description: A zone-control support who deploys 3 mechanical devices at battle start, activating them one per Ultimate cast to build toward a field-wide Fusion effect. Anchored to his Forge, he gains unlimited range and damage reduction in exchange for total immobility.

skills.name: Ultimate Domain
skills.description: Passive: At the start of battle, summons 3 inactive mechanical devices onto the field. Active: Activates the furthest device, expanding its area of effect. Allies inside recover HP equal to 50% of ATK and 15 Energy per second; enemies inside have ATK reduced by 15% and ATK SPD reduced by 20%. When all 3 devices are active, all enemies' DMG is reduced by 20% and all allies' DMG is increased by 30% and ATK SPD by 50% for 5 seconds. Subsequent Ultimate casts also trigger this Fusion effect.

upgrades.level2: HP and Energy recovered per second by allies inside activated devices increased.
upgrades.level3: ATK and ATK SPD reduction on enemies inside devices increased.
upgrades.level4: Fusion effect amplified: greater enemy DMG reduction and higher ally DMG and ATK SPD boost.

skills.name: Weakness Analysis
skills.description: Fires a laser to Restrain the enemy with the highest DMG for 2 seconds. The duration is extended by 0.5 seconds for each activated device on the field. While restrained, the target's Armor and Magical RED are reduced by 20%.

upgrades.level2: Armor and Magical RED reduction increased.
upgrades.level3: Restrain duration extension per activated device increased.
upgrades.level4: Armor and Magical RED reduction increased again.

skills.name: Force Shield
skills.description: Heals the weakest ally for HP equal to 150% of ATK and reduces their DMG taken by 10% for 5 seconds. For each activated device on the field, DMG taken is further reduced by 5%.

upgrades.level3: DMG reduction per activated device increased.

skills.name: Origin Resonance
skills.description: Hephaestus's Energy Regen is increased by 20%.

upgrades.level3: Energy Regen increase is higher again.
upgrades.level4: Gains initial Energy at the start of battle.

relic.name: Undying Forge
relic.description: At the start of battle, Hephaestus places a forge. If he leaves it, the forge teleports him back and puts him in an Overload state, unable to act for 5 seconds. While at the forge, Hephaestus enters a Focused state, gaining infinite attack range and taking 30% less DMG.

upgrades.level2: In Focused state: cooldowns of Weakness Analysis and Force Shield reduced.
upgrades.level3: In Focused state: Energy cost to cast Ultimate Domain reduced.
upgrades.level4: In Focused state: DMG taken further reduced.
